text:
maya: Flying into Chicago Tues for the conf. Need a quick-ish lunch near McCormick Place around 12:30. Pizza, burgers, or salads?

jonathan: Au Cheval is amazing but long waits. The Loyalist is next door and usually faster for a proper burger.

samir: Pequod's for deep dish but add 20-30m. Little Goat is good if you want brunch style.

rachel: For tacos/tavern vibes try Tavernita. For speedy salads/sandwiches, Summer House has good options.

maya: Sounds like Loyalist wins for speed. Anyone know walking time from the convention center?

jonathan: ~10-12 min depending on lights.

samir: Poll: :hamburger: Loyalist (fast), :pizza: Pequod's (deep dish), :taco: Tavernita (casual), :green_salad: Summer House (healthy)

jonathan: :hamburger:

rachel: :hamburger:

maya: Locking in Loyalist 12:30 Tue. Thanks!

ops-bot: calendar: Event created "West Loop Lunch - Maya + team" Tue 12:30-13:30 @ The Loyalist.
